0022600095.text: The Mavericks (0-1, 11th in the West, fifth in the Southwest and one game back) visit the Indiana Pacers (1-0, seventh in the East, second in the Central) in Dallas's second game of the season. Dallas is without Caleb Martin, Dereck Lively II, Santi Aldama and Tarik Biberovic, and Jett Howard is day-to-day with a calf injury and a game-time decision, while Indiana is without Johnny Furphy and T.J. McConnell, and Aaron Nesmith and Ben Sheppard are both day-to-day with game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet this season, and Dallas won both meetings in the 2025-26 season, most recently a 134-130 road win in Indianapolis on February 22, 2026.
